title: Fema / RBI | NRNR Account Reinvestment Violations Attract FEMA Penalty but Not Automatic Confiscation: Delhi HC
description: Delhi HC upholds FEMA penalties for NRNR account violations but sets aside confiscation for lack of reasons under Section 13(2).The post NRNR Account Reinvestment Violations Attract FEMA Penalty but Not Automatic Confiscation: Delhi HC appeared first on TaxGuru.
